NAME:
   probe - urfave/cli v3 probe

USAGE:
   probe [global options]

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --force, -f               skip confirmation prompts
   --limit int, -n int       maximum number of results to return, a deliberately long description (default: 0)
   --dry-run                 print what would change
   --output FILE, -o FILE    write output to FILE
   --print-config-dir, --cd  multi-letter alias
   --help, -h                show help
